query:
SELECT 
  data,
  (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as total,
  updatedAt
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-seraphine' 
  AND data >= '2026-05-27'
  AND data <= '2026-05-31'
ORDER BY data;
